court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: District Judge -9 and Additional Sessions Judge,Thane in Sessions Case No.37 of 2015
case_name: Vidyasagar Irappa Mane vs The State Of Maharashtra
facts_of_case: Appellant was convicted for offences punishable under Section 417 and 494 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to imprisonment. He was granted bail by this Court but preferred Criminal Application No.197 of 2018 for reduction of the bail amount.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove that the information given by him was true.
legal_principles.held: It is the defence of the appellant that he had informed to Mrs. Shyamal that his first wife left him and was not traceable for about two years and therefore it was construed that she died.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not interfere with the findings of fact by the trial court unless those findings are perverse or unreasonable.
legal_principles.held: The learned Trial Court after recording the evidence and after hearing the parties to the said case was pleased to acquit the appellant from all other charges and convicted the appellant for the offences punishable under Section 417 and 494 of the Indian Penal Code.

outcome.final_order: Appellant's sentence reduced, he is released on bail
